parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.description: Return item(s) associated with the specified Action Plan Template Section ID(s).

parameters.description: Return item(s) associated with the specified Action Plan Template ID.

id.description: Unique identifier of the deleted template item.

plan_template_item_assignees.description: Assignees responsible for this template item, rendered in compact view.

items.description: Company Action Plan Template Item Assignee (Compact)

created_at.description: Timestamp when the template item was created. ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the template item was moved to the recycle bin. ISO 8601 format.

description.description: Detailed description of the work or inspection activity for this template item.

holding_type.description: Scope of the hold point. 'section' holds subsequent items within the same section; 'plan' holds all subsequent items across the entire plan.

plan_template_id.description: Unique identifier of the parent Action Plan Template.

position.description: Ordinal position of this item within its section. Use to determine display order.

plan_template_section_id.description: Unique identifier of the section this template item belongs to.

title.description: Title of the template item describing the inspection or work activity.

due_at.description: Due date for the recycled template item.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the template item was last modified. ISO 8601 format.
